status: DERIVED, AUTO_EXTRACTED_UNREVIEWED (navigation, never evidence: 'primary' orders copies, it is not a claim of authorship or priority; a formula group shows where the same written form occurs, not a checked law)
user_decision: 29.09: duplicates of figures, tables and formulas are to be done

design.part: object_duplicates: a sibling of the part duplicates, not an extension
why_sibling: its own rule version object_duplicates_v1: duplicates_v1 and its datasets stay byte-stable
other inputs: figure images from the artifact root (--artifacts) instead of text units and dense vectors
its own compute profile: CPU processes decode the images, no GPU
it reads the text results of duplicates (source_overlap, dup_members) as context: publication groups and text-aligned pages
design.figure_image: per figure its FIGURE_CROP artifact (page-render crop, found through canonical.artifacts), else its native embedded image; decoded read-only with Pillow
design.kind_rule: the first rule that applies: all member sources copies of one work -> SAME_WORK_COPY; template objects -> BOILERPLATE; only caption evidence between different works -> REDRAWN; all member works in one publication group -> REPRINT; otherwise REUSED_FIGURE / REUSED_TABLE / SHARED_FORMULA
design.primary_rule: as duplicates_v1: earliest publication_year; ties: original works before containers and derivatives, then the object nearer the start of its source, then work_id; UNKNOWN_YEAR when a member year is missing; NOT_APPLICABLE for BOILERPLATE; copies of one work: FULL_COPY link, anchor source, source_id

queries.copies_of_object: copies_of_object(con, object_id, *, limit=50) -> {query, object_type, clusters: [cluster fields + this, copies, copies_truncated, this_is_primary], note}
queries.shared_formulas: shared_formulas(con, ref, *, renamed=True, limit=50); ref = formula id or LaTeX -> {query, match, latex_key, trivial, distinctive, exact, renamed (by work, earliest year first), n_exact, n_renamed, clusters, n_works, note}
queries.registered: store.QUERY_FUNCTIONS; api/ and mcp/ not touched

build.where: WORKSTATION (WSL, CPU only): read-only DuckDB copy of the snapshot, NAV build of the snapshot as --inputs, STAGING artifact root read only
build.command: vkm-corpus nav build --duckdb <snapshot DuckDB copy> --out <dir> --part object_duplicates --inputs <NAV build of the snapshot> --artifacts <artifact root>
build.environment: Python 3.13.15, numpy 2.5.3, Pillow 12.3.0, duckdb 1.5.5, pyarrow 25.0.1 (the versions of requirements/corpus-services.lock.txt used by the job image)
build.reproducibility: the rebuild from the committed code (7afcd0d, no hash cache) and a run through a console-script entry point with 8 workers gave byte-identical Parquet for all four datasets (equal sha256)

full_build_on_core.image: rebuild the api / vkm-job image from this branch (docker build -f infra/core/api/Dockerfile ...); Pillow and numpy are already in it; api and mcp need the same image to serve the two new query functions
full_build_on_core.build: docker compose --env-file .env --profile jobs run --rm -T vkm-job nav build --duckdb /data/duckdb/vkm_corpus.duckdb --out /data/derived/navigation/<SNAP> --inputs /data/derived/navigation/<SNAP> --part object_duplicates --artifacts /data/artifacts --option object_duplicates.workers=8
full_build_on_core.writes: four Parquet files beside the NAV datasets of <SNAP> and the entries parts.object_duplicates and datasets.* of its manifest.json (build_parts merges into a manifest of the same snapshot); the canon, the DuckDB and the artifacts are only read; nav.duckdb is untouched until pack
full_build_on_core.pack: docker compose --env-file .env --profile jobs run --rm -T --entrypoint python vkm-job -c "from vkm_corpus.navigation.store import pack; print(pack('/data/derived/navigation/<SNAP>'))"
full_build_on_core.serve: NavStore reopens nav.duckdb on the next query (mtime, size, inode); CURRENT stays
full_build_on_core.expected: about 45 s wall; 17,733 images hashed by 8 processes in about 23 s; peak RSS about 3.2 GB (main process, mostly the --inputs datasets) plus the workers; sha256 equal to this receipt for the same snapshot and artifacts (same library versions)
full_build_on_core.rerun: figure_hashes of the directory is offered back through --inputs as a hash cache (by artifact id and hash rule): about 24 s
full_build_on_core.fallback: --option object_duplicates.workers=1 hashes in the calling process (no process pool)
full_build_on_core.workstation_alternative: vkm-corpus nav build --part all ... --artifacts <STAGING artifact root>: the part runs after duplicates in the same build; without --artifacts and without VKM_DATA_ROOT the figures get status NO_ARTIFACT_ROOT (tables and formulas are still built)

model_choices.assignment: figures and tables: per object and other source the best verified partner (evidence tier, distance, caption), kept only when mutual; clusters = connected components
model_choices.figure_boilerplate: every member caption-less and template-like (max side < fig_boilerplate_small px, or <= fig_boilerplate_max_side px on the first or last page of its source), or caption-less in >= fig_boilerplate_min_works works with >= half template-like
model_choices.figure_caption: caption body without the printed number, NFKC, case fold, letters and digits, look-alike letters folded; shingles of fig_caption_k characters; similarity = |A∩B| / min(|A|, |B|)
model_choices.figure_caption_context: CAPTION: caption similarity >= fig_caption_strong while the images do not match closely, accepted only with context — two copies of one work with the same printed number (unique in each source), or pages within aligned_slack_pages of pages sharing a text passage (part duplicates) — and only while the images stay loosely alike (best distance <= fig_caption_max_distance); between different works the cluster is REDRAWN
model_choices.figure_distance: min(pHash of the whole crop, pHash of the content box); a rotation or mirror only for two images of >= fig_transform_min_side px when it gives a strong match (<= fig_strong_max) with agreeing aspect ratios and its own dHash
model_choices.figure_hashes: exact bin-average reduction (numpy); pHash = 8×8 low-frequency DCT of a 32×32 thumbnail against the median of its AC terms; dHash = horizontal gradients of a 9×9 thumbnail; content box = rows/columns with >= 0.2 % ink (|grey - border median| > fig_ink_delta); the content-box hashes are also taken under the 8 rotations/mirrors (D4) of the square thumbnail
model_choices.figure_image: page-render crop (FIGURE_CROP), else the native embedded image; decoded with Pillow to grey levels (alpha composited on white)
model_choices.figure_verification: the content-box aspect ratios agree within fig_max_aspect_ratio; IMAGE: d <= fig_strong_max and dHash <= fig_strong_dhash_max; IMAGE_CAPTION: d <= fig_medium_max, dHash <= fig_medium_dhash_max and (caption similarity >= fig_caption_support or the same printed number); CAPTION_IMAGE: d <= fig_weak_max and caption similarity >= fig_caption_strong; low-information images (grey-level std < fig_min_std, ink < fig_min_ink, or max side < fig_min_side px) only when identical
model_choices.formula_canonical: parser of the part formulas; Greek variants unified; fonts, spacing, \left/\right, \tag and alignment dropped; \cdot, \times, * dropped (implicit product); relation commands to signs; decimal comma to point; braces kept after \frac, \sqrt, \binom and for scripts; trailing punctuation removed
model_choices.formula_context: LATEX_RENAMED links are dropped when the «где …» definitions (formula_symbols) of the two forms share no word stem while both have >= 2 definitions, or when the forms keep no symbol (coordinates and indices x, y, z, t, r, i, j, k, n, m, ξ, η, ζ, τ do not count) in the same place and no definitions agree (a generic form: a polynomial, an additive split, a total differential, a gradient); a structure that one source uses for two different canonical forms is generic and never merged by renaming
model_choices.formula_distinctive: >= formula_shape_min_tokens tokens, >= formula_shape_min_ids identifiers and a structural operation (fraction, power, root, function, sum, integral, derivative)
model_choices.formula_near: LATEX_NEAR: formulas of two sources with the same printed number on pages that share a text passage (part duplicates), both non-trivial, token ratio >= formula_near_min_ratio (OCR variants of one formula in copies and reprints)
model_choices.formula_shape: identifiers (letter + accents + primes + subscript) renamed v1, v2 … in order of first occurrence; numbers, functions and operators kept
model_choices.formula_trivial: no relation sign, fewer than two identifiers or formula_min_tokens tokens, or no operation (notation, ranges, equalities of two symbols)
model_choices.primary: as in duplicates_v1: earliest publication_year; ties: SECONDARY_WORK_TYPES after original works, then the object nearer the start of its source, then work_id; UNKNOWN when a member year is missing; the copy of a work: FULL_COPY link, anchor source, source_id
model_choices.publication_groups: works joined by text reprints (source_overlap REPRINT / SHARED_ABSTRACT or >= reprint_min_shared_text shared passages) and curated relations (ABSTRACT_OF, COMPANION_OF; CONTAINS_COPY_OF, DERIVED_FROM, SHARES_PAGES_WITH)
model_choices.table_text: cells row by row (math spans as plain text), NFKC, case fold, letters and digits only, look-alike letters folded; header = the first row (or header_rows rows)
model_choices.table_verification: CELLS: containment >= table_min_containment and >= table_min_shared shared shingles, the rows below the header contained >= table_min_body_containment (a header-only table: containment >= table_header_only_containment), and when both tables carry numbers their number windows and their sets of informative numbers agree >= table_min_numbers_agree (the same row labels with other values are another table); NUMBERS: the numbers of the cells in reading order (digits only, so 16,42 = 16.42 = 1642 after a lost comma), windows of table_number_k numbers with >= 2 informative numbers (a fraction or three significant digits) that are not an arithmetic progression, containment >= table_min_number_containment and >= table_min_number_shared shared windows (tables with >= table_min_numbers informative numbers)

counts.FIGURE_hashing_note: hashed = distinct images decoded; status counts figure rows (a few images serve several figure rows); DECODE_ERROR = WMF images

timings.note: WORKSTATION CPU under WSL, memory capped at 12 GB without swap (systemd-run scope)

qa.method: random.Random(2026).sample(clusters of one (object_type, kind) sorted by cluster_id, min(30, n)); agent U2 judged every sampled cluster. Figures: composites of the member images with distances, transform, caption similarity and context - all viewed for REUSED_FIGURE, REDRAWN and BOILERPLATE; REPRINT viewed unless the pair was identical or near-identical with caption support; SAME_WORK_COPY 4 of 30 viewed, the other 26 accepted as page-aligned pages of the two copies of one work with image distance <= 2. Tables: header and first rows of every member (SAME_WORK_COPY: page-aligned copies, cell containment >= 0.70, number containment >= 0.87). Formulas: raw and canonical LaTeX of every member. correct = every member is the same object as the reference (a panel or a fragment of the same table counts; REDRAWN: the same figure drawn again) and the kind fits
qa.tuning_note: thresholds were set over six earlier rounds on the same snapshot with the same seed, so the final sample overlaps the earlier ones; REDRAWN is its whole population and fig_caption_max_distance = 24 was chosen on it: its precision is optimistic

wrong.note: two different charts (rate curves vs cumulative curves) under one caption pattern
residual plots of different data under one caption pattern
one member is a near-identical sibling figure of the same source (the same axes with other model lines), not the reused figure
specification tables of two different machines: the same generic row labels, other values

earlier_rounds: rotated legend swatches matched as quarter turns -> rotations/mirrors only for images >= fig_transform_min_side px, images < fig_min_side px only when identical
smooth images of other proportions matched -> content-box aspect ratios must agree (fig_max_aspect_ratio)
logos on edge pages of short articles -> template-like = small, or on the first/last page and <= fig_boilerplate_max_side px
caption-only links between different drawings -> CAPTION needs context and loose image likeness (identity distance <= fig_caption_max_distance)
table chains through shared number windows -> informative windows only, >= table_min_number_shared, agreeing number sets, containment of the rows below the header always checked

renamed-formula merges of generic structures (polynomials, additive splits, total differentials) -> generic-shape rule, symbol anchor with weak anchors excluded, d and Delta before a symbol read as operators; SHARED_FORMULA went from 26-29/30 in earlier rounds to 30/30

figures_same_work_label_caption.definition: two copies of one work: figures with the same printed number, unique in each source, caption containment >= 0.8 (>= 20 letters); found = both in one cluster

figures_text_reprint_caption.definition: source pairs of different works with relation REPRINT in source_overlap: figures with captions unique in their sources and caption containment >= 0.9 (>= 30 letters)

missed.verdict: SAME_FIGURE_MISSED: one panel of a two-panel figure, redrawn
SAME_FIGURE_MISSED: redrawn and turned by 90 degrees, dimensions changed
SAME_FIGURE_MISSED: two scans of one printed chart, distance 24-26
DIFFERENT_FIGURES: two different maps, generic caption
DIFFERENT_FIGURES: the same axes, other data sets
DIFFERENT_FIGURES: relaxation vs creep curves, same caption
DIFFERENT_FIGURES: two different geodetic sketches, same caption
DIFFERENT_FIGURES: the same concept drawn differently
DIFFERENT_TABLES: near-equal caption, other columns and values
DIFFERENT_TABLES: near-equal caption, other columns and values

formulas_same_work_same_number.definition: copies of one work: formulas with the same printed number, unique per source, both non-trivial

missed.reason: OCR variants of one short formula that differ in the case of three subscripts: token ratio 0.5 < formula_near_min_ratio; too short for the renamed form

formulas_aligned_text_pages_same_number.definition: pages that share one text passage (dup_members): formulas of two sources with the same printed number, both non-trivial
formulas_aligned_text_pages_same_number.note: not independent of LATEX_NEAR, which joins such pairs when the token ratio >= 0.6; the independent part is the key match 70/81; the one miss is the pair above
